researchReview.scope: Full 32-team / 16-game Week 3 current-information review from the latest verified broad Daily Review coverage endpoint, incorporating the verified Thursday late-day Delta bridge and all material developments through the Friday cutoff.

signConvention.spreadHome: Negative = home favorite; positive = home underdog.
signConvention.gap: Pinnacle home spread minus Graham home fair. Positive = Graham stronger on home; negative = Graham stronger on away.
signConvention.moneylinePair: Displayed as away / home American prices.

personnelEstimateCases.assumptionRationale: Henderson finished in the vacant boundary role. Assume he remains primary; the club has not fixed the full Week 3 alignment.
personnelEstimateCases.precision: Estimated injury loss rounded once to 0.001; subsequent weekly arithmetic is exact.
personnelEstimateCases.limitation: Replacement allocation is a labelled Graham estimate using frozen values. It is not confirmed workload or an empirical confidence interval. QB, playing impairment, displaced roles and unsupported clusters remain separate.
personnelEstimateCases.reopenOn: An alternate starter, Avieon outside shift, or a Henderson availability change.

personnelEstimateCases.assumptionRationale: Assume equal added outside-receiver duty for Treadwell and Slayton, the two reserves listed in Pierce's depth-chart row. These are assumed shares, not measured targets or snaps.
personnelEstimateCases.precision: Estimated injury loss rounded once to 0.001; subsequent weekly arithmetic is exact.
personnelEstimateCases.limitation: Replacement allocation is a labelled Graham estimate using frozen values. It is not confirmed workload or an empirical confidence interval. QB, playing impairment, displaced roles and unsupported clusters remain separate.
personnelEstimateCases.reopenOn: Pierce participates, a formal designation contradicts the reported absence, one reserve is unavailable, or reported role allocation supersedes the equal-share assumption.

personnelEstimateCases.assumptionRationale: Assume the listed reserve edges share Clemons's added rotation duty equally. The frozen healthy value is zero, so nonnegative replacements yield zero injury loss for every allocation.
personnelEstimateCases.precision: Estimated injury loss rounded once to 0.001; subsequent weekly arithmetic is exact.
personnelEstimateCases.limitation: Replacement allocation is a labelled Graham estimate using frozen values. It is not confirmed workload or an empirical confidence interval. QB, playing impairment, displaced roles and unsupported clusters remain separate.
personnelEstimateCases.reopenOn: A reserve becomes unavailable, the rotation changes, another line absence creates cluster exposure, or the frozen-value authority is amended.
